task_description: Determine whether famfs_kill_sb releases the DAX device reference before or after kill_char_super() runs shrink_dcache_for_umount(), and whether anything in the DAX holder/teardown path holds dentry references.
instructions: Read fs/famfs/famfs_inode.c: find and read famfs_kill_sb in full
Determine the order of operations: does famfs_kill_sb call kill_char_super() before or after releasing the dax device (fs_put_dax, dax_dev_put, etc.)?
Read fs/famfs/famfs_inode.c: find famfs_dax_notify_failure and the dax_holder_ops struct - do these hold dentry or file references?
Read the famfs_fs_info structure definition - does it contain dentry, file, or inode pointer fields?
Check whether kill_char_super -> generic_shutdown_super -> shrink_dcache_for_umount runs BEFORE famfs_kill_sb releases dax references
Verify false positives: confirm the dentry refcount of 1 cannot be explained by normal VFS behavior at this point in teardown

call_trace_summary: umount_check (WARNING: dentry still in use refcount=1)
context_from_bug.reproducer_summary: manual mount then unmount of famfs filesystem; multiple dentries still in use at unmount

questions_to_answer: Does famfs_kill_sb call kill_char_super() before releasing the dax device reference?
Does the dax holder teardown path (famfs_dax_notify_failure or similar) hold any dentry references?
Does famfs_fs_info contain any dentry, file, or inode pointer fields that are not dropped before kill_char_super?
